title: @c15t/astro: Astro Cookie Banner and Consent Management
description: Cookie banner, preference dialog, and consent-gated scripts for Astro 5, 6, and 7. The banner is plain `.astro` markup with no framework JavaScript. The preference dialog loads as a Svelte, React, or Vue island only when a visitor opens it.
features: Visitors download no UI framework for the banner. The dialog's framework loads only when a visitor opens it
Write the dialog island in Svelte, React, or Vue, so it uses the framework your site already ships
Static output works on any static host with `hosted()`. Server output resolves each visitor's policy, so the banner is in the first HTML
Geo-aware middleware reads location and language headers from your host
Analytics, ads, and pixels follow each visitor's choice through @c15t/integrations: Google Tag Manager, Google Consent Mode v2, GA4, Meta Pixel, PostHog, and more
IAB TCF 2.4 banner and dialog components
prerequisites: One of `@astrojs/svelte`, `@astrojs/react`, or `@astrojs/vue` for the preference dialog
A server adapter for server output, or none for static output
An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), a [self-hosted backend](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/quickstart), or offline mode for local development
manualInstallation: The `c15t` package re-exports this package at `c15t/astro`, and the docs use that path. For React or Vue dialogs, install `@astrojs/react react react-dom` or `@astrojs/vue vue` instead of Svelte. `@astrojs/node` is the server adapter in the example below. Use your host's adapter instead, or leave it out for static output.
usage: Set `PUBLIC_C15T_BACKEND_URL` to your Inth backend URL in `.env`
Register your UI framework, then `c15t()`, in `astro.config.mjs`

```js
// astro.config.mjs
import node from '@astrojs/node'
import svelte from '@astrojs/svelte'
import { defineConfig } from 'astro/config'
import c15t from 'c15t/astro'

export default defineConfig({
  adapter: node({ mode: 'standalone' }),
  integrations: [svelte(), c15t()],
  output: 'server',
})
```
Add `ConsentScript` to `<head>`, and `ConsentBanner`, `ConsentDialog`, and `ConsentDialogLink` to your layout, from `c15t/astro/components`
For static output, the full layout, and island options, see the [Astro quickstart](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/astro/quickstart)
